satellite.heading: 3. Go / no-go — FINAL, pixel-level QC complete
satellite.excerpt:
**Primary event (Oct 2016): NO-GO for image-based validation.** The only
candidate post-event scene (2016-11-02, +5 days) numerically clears the gate
(cloud, timing) but **fails the visual-plume criterion** — confirmed by two
independent sensors (Sentinel-2 + Landsat 8) and explained by the in-situ
mooring record showing the plume signal had already dispersed 2.5–3.5 days
before either satellite pass (§1a). This is not a weak/marginal result to
grade Silver or Bronze — it's a genuine null: **no plume is present in any
imagery this project can access for this event**, for a real physical reason
(dispersal faster than the revisit gap), not a data-quality problem.

**Backup event (Feb 2013): weaker still.** No Sentinel-2 possible at all
(pre-launch); Landsat 8 unavailable (pre-commissioning); only degraded
Landsat 7 remains, and even that can't be properly scored until the exact
date resolves (§2).

mooring_target.citation: Kalman, A., Katz, T., Vincze, M., Longenecker, J., Mathalon, A., Hill, P., and Goodman-Tchernov, B. (2025). Anatomy of a Flash Flood in a Hyperarid Environment: From Atmospheric Masses to Sediment Dispersal in the Sea. Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences, 25, 3201-3219.

provenance.turbidity_onset: reported (timezone-converted from 09:50 local, IDT UTC+3, via ZoneInfo)
provenance.turbidity_cleared: reported (timezone-converted from 17:15 local Oct 29, IDT UTC+3, via ZoneInfo)
provenance.elevated_duration_hours: derived (differenced from the two timestamps above; matches paper's own '~31 h' prose statement)

position.note: Paper states only '~250 m offshore the Kinnet Canal outlet, 13 m depth', no decimal coordinate. Do not use to more precision than the 1.5 km radius implies. Do not substitute AQ-O01 (Wadi Yutum, Jordan) for this point -- see derivation doc §0.

calibration_use.why_never: No real observed plume mask exists for AQ-2016-10-28 (the Sentinel-2 extraction is a documented artifact, not ground truth -- see docs/pitch_limitations.md and docs/event_audit.md). Spatial metrics against this target would be meaningless.

modelled_blocked_on: no registered simulation run (data/outputs/<run_id>/ has never been created)

calibration_fit.selected_regime_verdict: hypopycnal (diffusion=5.0 m2/s, windage=0.0, settling=0.1 mm/s, objective=33.622 h)
calibration_fit.forcing_placeholder_reason: no historical marine wind source in this repo; wind_fn = ConstantWindField(0, 0)
calibration_fit.windage_caveat: wind_fn is identically (0, 0), so every windage_fraction in the grid contributes the same zero drift -- this run's winning windage_fraction is a tie-break artifact, not a calibrated value. Recalibrate once real historical wind (ERA5-Land u10/v10 for this window, per models.calibration's own note) is available.
calibration_fit.peak_timing_caveat: the mooring target's peak time is the onset/clear midpoint (mooring_target['_parsed']['peak_is_midpoint_placeholder']), not a digitized observation -- peak_timing_error_hours is measured against that placeholder, not a reported peak.
